mining.prompt: Inspect this industrial image for defects. Return JSON only: {"is_anomalous": true or false}.
mining.rule: Base model boolean log likelihood odds; no validation/test outcomes or adapters participate

arms.normal_random: Fresh DD: random32/category from same96 normal pool
arms.normal_hard: Fresh DD:16 highest base log odds + fixed-seed random16 from remaining80/category
arms.region_highres: Exact v2 RR exposure manifest bytes/order; max_pixels1048576 only input-budget change

training.anomalies: Fixed v2 DD384 anomaly identities and original schedule

fairness.training_audit_required: Verify actual initial trainable parameter hashes and exposure logs across arms
fairness.highres: Paired to existing v2 RR at524288; same source/order/config except budget and output paths

evaluation.reuse: Exact frozen v2 validation bytes, development comparison
evaluation.small_area_q1_definition: data._quantile linear interpolation: position=(n-1)*0.25; ordered[floor(position)] + (ordered[ceil(position)]-ordered[floor(position)])*(position-floor(position)); fixed384 unique v2 DD train anomalies only; small iff area_fraction <= threshold
evaluation.confirmation_policy: Read IDs for isolation only; no image/model/prediction access

limits: normal labels assumed correct; no manual defect review
source hashes do not establish physical-part independence
hard means model-confusing, not necessarily ambiguous or mislabeled
v2 validation has already informed this development direction
